sparse_gate.design: sparse gating per model - the K3 ternary head classifies/abstains; it does not ternarise the base model's weights
sparse_gate.verdict: change_shipped false - no candidate beats held-out blocking while keeping benign false-blocks under 1%; gate remains advisory

conclusion: Per-model sparse gating is the design; whole-model ternarisation is what produced the unusable Bonsai GGUFs. A working base model (IQ2_M) on :8587 plus the existing K3 gate at :8022/k3/classify is the configuration the codebase already implements.
